mob_official.title: Escape From Playtime: A Smiling Critters Adventure | Reveal Trailer
mob_official.caption: Escape From Playtime: A Smiling Critters Adventure is a new co-op survival horror experience in the Poppy Playtime universe. Sign up for upcoming Playtests and wishlist the game here https://huggywug.co/4xYQ9hl Explore the dark depths of an abandoned toy factory while outmaneuvering the violent toys that hunt you in the shadows. In each run, a mysterious voice drives you to collect the necessary parts scattered around the factory to earn your freedom. The denizens of the factory - fellow rejected Playtime Co. creations - stalk the decaying halls, hunting for prey. You and your friends must work together and utilize your surroundings if you hope to make it out of the factory in one piece. But who or what you’re collecting the parts for… is unknown. _________________________________________________________ Get Poppy Playtime Chapter 5 NOW!
